tasks.title: SMF drum parser
tasks.prompt: Create MidiPattern parseDrumSmf(Uint8List bytes,{int maxBars=4,int stepsPerBeat=4}) importing models/midi_pattern.dart. Parse a Standard MIDI File (format 0 or 1): MThd, ppq, all MTrk chunks, variable-length deltas, running status, skip meta/sysex events. Collect NOTE ON (status 0x99, velocity>0) on MIDI channel 10 only; step = round(tick/ppq*stepsPerBeat). Assume 4/4: bars = clamp(ceil((lastStep+1)/(4*stepsPerBeat)),1,maxBars); drop hits with step >= maxBars*4*stepsPerBeat. name = 'Imported'. Throw FormatException on bad header or truncated data. Must satisfy docs/plans/midi-drums/tests/smf_parser_test.dart. Edit only the listed file(s); create it if missing; match existing style; do not modify tests. When done print DONE.
tasks.verify: mkdir -p test/midi && cp docs/plans/midi-drums/tests/smf_parser_test.dart test/midi/ && flutter test test/midi/smf_parser_test.dart 2>&1 | tail -3 | rg -q 'All tests passed'

tasks.title: Drum lane renderer
tasks.prompt: Create Float32List renderLane(MidiPattern p, DrumLane lane, double bpm, Float32List sample,{int sampleRate=44100}). Output length = (p.totalSteps/p.stepsPerBeat*60/bpm*sampleRate).round(). For each hit whose laneForNote(hit.note)==lane, add sample*(vel/127) starting at frame round(step/stepsPerBeat*60/bpm*sampleRate); samples that run past the end wrap to the start (loop). Overlaps sum. Must satisfy docs/plans/midi-drums/tests/drum_loop_renderer_test.dart. Edit only the listed file(s); create it if missing; match existing style; do not modify tests. When done print DONE.
tasks.verify: mkdir -p test/midi && cp docs/plans/midi-drums/tests/drum_loop_renderer_test.dart test/midi/ && flutter test test/midi/drum_loop_renderer_test.dart 2>&1 | tail -3 | rg -q 'All tests passed'
